annotations.title: A domain's latest public report, as data

description: Wraps GET /check/{domain}/data.json. A domain's latest public report, as data. The newest public report for a domain, the same data POST /check answers. Reading never starts a look. A private report is at its own address: the report's permalink plus /data.json. Needs no key.
name: check_report

checked_at.description: When the look was made (ISO 8601, UTC)

checks_version.description: The checks' version: /check/method#changes says what each changed

confirmed_at.description: The newest look that found the same (ISO 8601, UTC)

domain.description: The domain the report is about

fix.description: How to fix it, when there's something to fix

id.description: Stable across looks: what reports compare

question.description: The question it answers: reach, understand, work, trust or shop

state.description: ok, warn (partly), missing, na (doesn't apply) or unknown (couldn't check this time)

text.description: What we found, in our words

tier.description: The standard's tier: newer ones count at half weight

weight.description: What it's worth in the score

method.description: How the check reads and scores

opted_out.description: The site's robots.txt asks our scanner not to look

cap.description: Why the grade is held at D, or null

covers.description: What the look read, and so what the score covers: not the pages it didn't read

questions.description: Each question's own score (reach, understand, work, trust, shop), or null when nothing in it counted

scope.description: Scored as a content site, or as a site with an API (its API files count)

score.description: 0 to 100: earned over possible, rounded down

verdict.description: What it adds up to, in our words

with_every_fix.description: The score with every fix made

word.description: The band's word: Ready, Mostly ready, Needs work, Hard to use or Closed

score.description: The score, or null when the site couldn't be scored

unreachable.description: Why the site couldn't be read, or null

title: A domain's latest public report, as data
